subject: Yoru
served: Abilities Yoru Abilities Yoru holds all of the standard Devil abilities, such as regeneration, reviving in Hell after being killed, restoring her health by consuming blood, fear empowerment and enhanced physical prowess. Despite being rather weak at the start, Yoru has the potential to become one of the strongest of the Four Horsemen, even strong enough to prevent the upcoming apocalypse. As stated by her elder sister, the Death Devil, Yoru in full power, is not only powerful enough to stop the apocalypse of her descend, but she is now able to make an apocalyptic scenario far worse than the one she wanted to prevent. Yoru planned to increase the world's fear of war, thereby restoring her power to its full potential. The Death Devil refers to this planned conflict as a "never-ending" World War II. Due to the California Governor's contract with Yoru, any fatal damage inflicted on Yoru is transferred to a random citizen of California. However, her contract with the Governor of California does not apply to self-inflicted injuries, as they cannot be offloaded onto American civilians. Yoru is also able to use a Contract Trigger ability because of her Gun Gauntlet. Abilities / Skillset Yoru Abilities / Skillset Spearmanship: Yoru also demonstrates her skills on using a spear during her fight against the reincarnated Eternity Devil.(Chapter 117) Gunmanship: After acquiring the Tank and Gun Gauntlets along with the transformed Statue of Liberty, Yoru demonstrates her ability to use their powers proficiently to fire bullets.(Chapter 176)(Chapter 177)(Chapter 178) Chapters 117 and 178 Abilities / Supernatural Abilities / Weapon Creation Yoru Abilities / Supernatural Abilities / Weapon Creation Yoru has the power to transform anything she owns into a weapon, whether it be an object or a living being. Initially, to activate the weapon transformation, Yoru had to touch what belongs to her and say the name of the weapon, but as her power increased, she and Asa became able to create a weapon without even touching the related object and telekinetically summon them regardless of distance without even calling their names verbally. The strength of the weapon is proportional to the amount of guilt Yoru and/or Asa feel in creating said weapon. There is no objective measure of when something belongs to Asa or Yoru, but the greater the guilt (such as Yoru's familial attachment to the Gun Devil and the Tank Devil), the more powerful the weapon will be. It should be noted that as her power relies on perception rather than reality, it’s possible to trick Yoru into thinking she doesn’t own/has power over something that she actually does, thereby nullifying her power’s effects. She falls back to the ground as the gravity manipulation does not affect her. Yoru orders Asa to keep focusing on her pain and proceeds to speculate about the devil's identity before correctly assuming that it is the Falling Devil and that Fami's likely involved. Trivia Asa Mitaka Trivia Asa's debut heavily parallels that of Denji as both her parents are deceased, and she is killed in a betrayal by someone close to her, the Class President, and in Denji's case, the yakuza handler. She is then revived by a Devil who inhabits her body, and uses the newfound powers she gained to kill her murderer. This was likely intentional, especially since the chapter titles for Chapter 1 and Chapter 98 parallel one another. Asa quickly grabs onto a nearby railing as she finds herself to be falling upside down. She used this ability to lift up an entire apartment building high into the air and then launch it towards the fleeing Denji and Asa.
